entry_points.text: Suspend validates, captures, selects vector by word size and sleeps paused; low-level entries preserve registers and wake vectors validate magic.
Boot parsing handles video, beep, storage, ordering and signature tokens; sealing neutralizes markers and a trap helper marks never-executed sites.
Early init patches all code while peers are stopped, coordinating checking, retpolines, returns, calls, alternatives and sealing with self-verification.
Breakpoint notifier emulates the self-test call on kernel hits; relocation check validates its argument against a dedicated integer.

exports.text: Secondary-bringup mailbox is recorded and readable by address and mapping; wakeup vector is exposed and sleep requests forward generically.
Flag records whether rewriting occurred; boot option selects debug categories defaulting to all with fixed prefix.
Module thunk init brackets preparation; retpoline rewriting and return-thunk desire queries are provided.
Return tables are walked and rewritten on size match; batch commit and call-to-thunk translation are provided.
Function hash and arity use gated fault-tolerant reads; trap decoders classify cases; fine-grained appliers drive rewriting.
NMI suppression uses balanced increment and decrement; enforcement state is saved before rewriting.

hazards.text: Magic mismatch faults or halts; bad shapes, stack-register use and allocation failures report without clobbering bytes; one helper always traps.
Boundary crossing, allocator phase and missing pages are fatal with mismatch unrecoverable; queues flush on overflow or disorder and commits yield.
Probing fails safe with manual fixup for mid-instruction traps; post-disable failures leave no checking; patching is non-atomic with checks enabled.
Missing types warn and abort; foreign calls skip silently; tracking save and restore preserve unrelated bits.

invariants.text: Resume needs header and magic agreement; flags record verified features; 64-bit MP resume uses a 4096-byte temp stack unless parallel bringup.
Real-mode bits 0-2 select BIOS, mode and beep; comma tokens control signature, storage, ordering and blacklist; unset S4 check enables on virtual hosts.
Thunk pages grow singly with trap fill past a 32-byte reserve, avoiding low halves of 64-byte lines; final protection is execute-only under strict mode.
Sites resolve as base plus displacement; 32-bit conditionals use an escape and invert; stack register is forbidden and returns need size match with trap fill.
Poke queue flushes when full or order breaks; call targets must be in core ranges and install only over expected NOPs.
Boot list selects auto, off, debug, kernel or fine-grained checking; seed rehash avoids marker collisions; tables resolve by entry plus signed displacement.
Preambles without markers are skipped and old markers are poisoned only after callers move; length mismatch aborts rewriting; self-tests demand exact outcomes.
Warning, decode, address, register, string and APIC helpers used by sleep and patching are owned outside and treated as opaque.

locks.text: Thunk init, batch commits and builtin call setup serialize on the text mutex.
Mappings hold the page lock with IRQs saved; boot work suppresses NMIs via paired calls and saves enforcement before rewriting.

state_machines.text: Suspend runs capture, request, then inline recovery or firmware-vectored resume by word size, ending in restoration.
Sites decode and classify; recognized branches rewrite per mitigations, returns become thunk jumps or lone returns, trampolines convert under lock.
Batch runs trap insert with sync, tail update, first-byte replace and drain; direct patches map pages, copy in temp space, verify, flush and chunk.
Auto resolves checking mode, disables, optionally randomizes, then rewrites preambles, callers and markers; boot orders test, suppression, rewrites, sealing and restore.

structs.text: Wakeup header holds signature, settings, snapshots, options, magic and resume addresses; patch descriptor holds target, metadata, buffer and length.
Queued record holds relative address, length, opcode, displacement, replacement and saved byte; CFI mode lives in read-only-after-init with exclusive defaults.
Preamble is 20 bytes with hash at 5 and trap at 19; caller is 14 with hash at 1; paranoid trap is at 13; decoders use IP, SP, accumulator and return slot.
Temp stack is 4096 bytes with fixed 32 and 64-bit magics; patch limit is 254; call opcode and rehash polynomial are fixed.
